message.content: {"caption":"Few-shot learning workflow showing how a language model self-edits augmentation and training settings, fine-tunes on generated examples, and applies the adapted model to an evaluation input.","description":"A left-to-right process diagram titled “Few-Shot Setup.” A collection of few-shot example grids is fed to a language model with parameters θₜ. The model produces a self-edit configuration: basic augmentations are true, while size, chain, and repeat augmentations are false; the strategy is loss on all tokens, the learning rate is 1e-05, and training runs for 3 epochs. The configuration is used to generate augmented grid examples, which are used in an SFT update with a loss function and θₜ to produce adapted parameters θ′ₜ. In the evaluation stage, a held-out grid is passed through the adapted language model to produce an output grid, marked as correct.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
